author: althoufx
text:
Hello Salivan

about the Engulf, from RTM we learned to take it as the most significant
 signal the price gives to show further moves. I think it's important
also to decide which Engulf are effective signals, and which Engulfs
can't have effects.

For example in EURUSD we can see Engulfs High followed by EGs Low , while the price consistently only goes up.

It happens because EG H always comes first in all 5 cases, then each EG
 Low is not valid because it always is preceded by a previous EG High..

Do you think is it correct ?

many thanks, all the best

author: salivan
text:
Hi althoufx

the only reliable ENG is the ENG of true zone(FL) , we don't look for
ENG of swings . and always bear in mind there is no engulf in south
without price reaching it's target for longs , and there is no engulf in
 north with out price reaching it's target for shorts . before reaching
the target PA is not PA .

hope it helps you

author: salivan
text:
I know where my entry point. But big mistakes with outs.

May be here in community I can find it but I can`t. Show me this article or messege please or tell:

1) Get out when we have opposite engulf in same TF in which we entry.

2) Get out half of possition on first oposite FTR, FL or s/r line. And another half in opposite demand or supply.

3) Get out all positiion on opposite demand or supply.

Very often I get out on first problem area by full poisition and due to this take only 40% of move.

Please tell what will be better, what you use?

a friend PMd me about the targets, for me there is no target without
FLs , about my targets i read the orders , i told that before that
targets are more important that entries , bcz when you know where the
target is, you know the whole story . it takes thousands of hours for
reading the market not drawing rectangles . the more you look at the
market in An ongoing basis the more you learn how to manage your trade .
 really about targets , i can say only this :

trade FLs and close it in FLs .

read the scales

understand orders not TFs.

i have nothing more to say .

hope it helps you .
